_comment: The foundational-literacy leaderboard's columns, in the order the website shows
them. Shared by every benchmark publishing to this leaderboard, which is why it
lives at the repo root rather than inside one of them.
A pair listed here with no records file is REPORTED AS MISSING by
'fab-leaderboard publish' rather than silently dropped -- that is the whole point
of naming the expected pairs instead of publishing whatever files happen to exist.
benchmark_domain is the id the website keys on and the records filename uses
Adding a language or a benchmark type means adding a row here and teaching that
benchmark to write the matching records file.
